subject: Coord: demo reschedule + cross-team redline session — time options inside

Subject: Demo reschedule + request to set redline + security sync

Hi Raj / Elena —

Quick update: we need to move the technical demo originally scheduled for 11/12. The ask from your side was twofold: (1) pull the SE through a short hands-on demo with your eng/security folks, and (2) run a separate contract redline review with your procurement/legal team so we can close the SOW.

To make this low-friction I sketched two options:
- Option A: Demo (30–45m) + Redline (45–60m) back-to-back on the same day so you only block one calendar window
- Option B: Separate days — demo first, redline the next day after your legal reviews

Proposed slots (times in UTC for clarity):
- Wed 2026-11-11: 16:00–17:30 UTC (demo + redline back-to-back)
- Fri 2026-11-13: 09:00–10:30 UTC (demo only) then 11:00–12:00 UTC (redline)
- Mon 2026-11-15: 14:00–15:30 UTC (demo + buffer for questions)

Could you share which of these work for your ENG / SECURITY / PROCUREMENT groups? If none are good, send 2–3 preferred windows and we’ll adapt. I attached the current redline draft (Starnet_Redline_Draft_v3.pdf) and the mutual action plan so legal/procurement have context.

Attachments: Starnet_Redline_Draft_v3.pdf (redline PDF), RWD_mutual_action_plan.xlsx (M A P)

Thanks — I’ll coordinate calendar invites once we lock a slot.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Dylan —

Appreciate the options. Quick notes from security/engineering: we need a separate redline call that includes our security lead (Elena Sokolov) and the platform engineer; security asks for at least a 45m block, and they prefer morning slots (their calendar fills up in the afternoon). Also, we typically need copies of the redline PDF 48 hours before the call for review.

From the options you proposed, we can do:
- Fri 2026-11-13: 09:00–10:30 UTC — we can do the demo then, but please do not expect security to participate in the redline at 11:00 unless you can shift earlier (they have a hard constraint)
- Mon 2026-11-15: 14:00–15:30 UTC is difficult for our EMEA security team (late evening local)

Alternative windows that would work for ENG + SECURITY here (UTC):
- Thu 2026-11-12: 08:00–09:30 UTC (demo) and Thu 2026-11-12: 10:00–11:00 UTC (redline)
- Fri 2026-11-13: 07:30–09:00 UTC (demo) / 09:30–10:30 UTC (redline) — tighter but possible

I’ll loop procurement on the reply so they can confirm necessary approvers and PO timing.

Elena
Elena Sokolov
Head of Cloud Security, Starnet Solutions

Dylan / team —

Quick legal perspective: we prefer a standalone redline session with their procurement/legal plus our commercial counsel present. Please note: we aim to review the attached Starnet_Redline_Draft_v3.pdf and mark core commercial terms in advance (cost, data residency, audit rights). If procurement needs to escalate any non-standard clauses, please flag those ahead of the call.

- Our legal counsel is only available Mon/Wed mornings PST next week (i.e., late afternoon UTC).
- If Starnet needs faster turnaround, we can do a 60-minute live session but will ask for a short follow-up to confirm agreed edits.

Action items for Dylan/AE:
1) Confirm whether Starnet wants demo + redline back-to-back (same-day) or separate sessions.
2) Re-send the redline PDF in searchable PDF (the one attached is fine but please include a clean copy).
3) If Starnet requests signature timelines or PO deadlines, add those to the MAP before the meeting.

Happy to join; cc'd Connor in case we want SE support on the redline for any technical annex questions.

Soojin Lee
